name: glossary-contrastive
title: Domain-specific glossary candidates
description: Term candidates that are specific to a domain corpus compared with a reference corpus: candidates are extracted from both, joined, scored by log-likelihood, log-ratio and C-value, filtered to clearly overrepresented terms and enriched with corpus evidence.

ref_corpus.description: General or contrasting reference corpus id (same language).

patterns.description: Token patterns; default: a set for the corpus language word order.

min_freq.description: Minimum frequency in the domain corpus.

min_log_ratio.description: Minimum log-ratio (1 = twice as frequent as in the reference).

export_path.description: Optional .xlsx/.tsv path for the final table.

interpretation: FREQUENCY_REF = 0 means the term never occurs in the reference corpus. LL measures how reliable the difference is, LOG_RATIO how large it is, CVALUE whether the candidate is a complete term rather than a fragment. Terms passing all three are strong domain-specific candidates. Check DP to avoid terms from a single text, verify DEFINITION contexts, and use EXAMPLE/TOP_COLLOCATES to draft entries.
